headline: Brzoska Reveals His Cards. That Is Why InPost Left the Stock Exchange
summary: Rafał Brzoska said InPost left the Amsterdam exchange after five years so it could invest faster, take on more debt and pursue acquisitions. Dividend payments may be deferred to an unspecified future date.
why: InPost is a parcel locker operator, and a delisting removes public market trading, changing how investors can hold the shares and how capital is raised.
original_headline: Brzoska odkrywa karty. Dlatego InPost zszedł z giełdy
